definitions.explanation: Describes things that lack uniformity in size, shape, quality, or alignment. Can refer to physical objects that do not match, or figuratively to a group of people with varied abilities or backgrounds.

examples.japanese: {不揃|ふぞろ}いな⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{安|やす}く→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦{売|う}っている→売る：00906_uru⟧。
examples.english: They are selling irregularly shaped vegetables cheaply.

examples.japanese: {歯並|はなら}び⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{不揃|ふぞろ}いで⟦{気|き}にしている→気にする：03026_kinisuru⟧。
examples.english: I am self-conscious about my uneven teeth.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大|おお}きさ→大きさ：10969_ookisa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{不揃|ふぞろ}いだ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{変|か}わらない→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{問題|もんだい}ない→問題ない：26594_mondainai⟧。
examples.english: The sizes are irregular, but the taste is the same so there is no problem.

notes:
USAGE: {不揃|ふぞろ}い describes a lack of uniformity. It is frequently used for produce, teeth, hair, handwriting, and other things expected to be even or matched.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{大|おお}きさ→大きさ：10969_ookisa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{不揃|ふぞろ}い (irregular in size)
- {不揃|ふぞろ}いな⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧ (irregularly shaped vegetables)
- {歯並|はなら}び⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{不揃|ふぞろ}い (uneven teeth)
- {不揃|ふぞろ}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{林檎|りんご}たち ("Imperfect Apples" — a famous 1983 TV drama title)

CULTURAL NOTE: {不揃|ふぞろ}い⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧ (irregularly shaped produce) has become a positive concept in recent years, as consumers embrace imperfect vegetables to reduce food waste.
